mentions.name: Onset
mentions.description: Onset is a release note management platform for publishing software releases privately and publicly, replacing release announcements scattered across email and Slack.
mentions.problem: Release announcements sent via email and Slack messages get lost.
mentions.audience: Teams and companies that need to communicate product releases.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.onset.io
A release note management platform. In my previous company, we were sending emails and slack messages for every release but they're all were lost in either. So I decided to build a place to share releases privately and publicly.
